  • Install the bulb in a compatible B22 or E27 lamp holder.
  • Download the Philips Smart app and follow the on-screen instructions to connect the bulb to your Wi-Fi network.

Q. Do I need a separate hub or gateway to use this smart bulb?

Yes. Once connected to the Philips Smart app, you can control your lighting remotely from anywhere with an internet connection.

Q. What is the difference between the B22 and E27 variants?
The difference lies in the lamp holder type. Choose B22 for bayonet cap fixtures and E27 for Edison screw-type fixtures.

Choose 9W for smaller rooms or bedside lamps, 10W for general-purpose lighting, and 12W for larger spaces or where brighter illumination is preferred.
